page: Microsoft Azure L24aos_v5 is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the Laosv5 family, powered by dedicated AMD processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its integrated local storage, which consists of 17281 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. The instance is also designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput storage operations. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

Given the high local storage capacity and the 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for storage-intensive and database workloads that require large local scratch space or high-capacity caching. The absence of dedicated GPU hardware makes it unsuitable for accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads, while the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention.
